data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_neon_enhancement_tex_adj_v2.Help
data.value: Correct some texture errors when the increased resolution modification is enabled. This can slightly reduce speed.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_spu_reverb.Help
data.value: Enable reverberation effects in the sound produced by the PSX SPU. Turning them off makes emulation faster, but reduces sound quality and fidelity.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_spu_interpolation.Help
data.value: Enable emulation of the in-built audio interpolation provided by the PSX SPU. 'Gaussian' sounds closest to original hardware. 'Simple' improves performance but reduces quality. 'Cubic' has the highest performance requirements but produces increased clarity. Can be disabled entirely for maximum performance, at the expense of greatly reduced audio quality.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_nocdaudio.Help
data.value: Enable playback of CD (CD-DA) audio tracks. Can be disabled to improve performance in games that include CD audio, at the expense of missing music.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_noxadecoding.Help
data.value: Enable playback of XA (eXtended Architecture ADPCM) audio tracks. Can be disabled to improve performance in games that include XA audio, at the expense of missing music.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_show_input_settings.Help
data.value: Show configuration options for all input devices: analog response, Multitaps, light guns, etc. Quick Menu may need to be toggled for this setting to take effect.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_analog_axis_modifier.Help
data.value: Specify range limits for the left and right analog sticks when input device is set to 'analog' or 'dualshock'. 'Square' bounds improve input response when using controllers with highly circular ranges that are unable to fully saturate the X and Y axes at 45 degree deflections.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_vibration.Help
data.value: Enable haptic feedback when using a rumble-equipped gamepad with input device set to 'dualshock'.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_analog_combo.Label
data.value: Button combination for switching the DualShock analog mode

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_analog_combo.Help
data.value: When the input device type is DualShock, this option allows the emulated DualShock to be toggled between DIGITAL and ANALOG mode like original hardware. You can select the button combination for this.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_multitap.Help
data.value: Connect a virtual PSX Multitap peripheral to either controller 'Port 1' or controller 'Port 2' for 5 player simultaneous input, or to both 'Ports 1 and 2' for 8 player input. Mutlitap usage requires compatible games.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_negcon_deadzone.Help
data.value: Set the deadzone of the RetroPad left analog stick when simulating the 'twist' action of emulated neGcon Controllers. Used to eliminate drift/unwanted input.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_negcon_response.Label
data.value: Response to rotation of the neGcon steering control

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_negcon_response.Help
data.value: Specify the analog response when using a RetroPad left analog stick to simulate the 'twist' action of emulated neGcon Controllers.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_input_sensitivity.Help
data.value: Adjust responsiveness of emulated 'mouse' input devices.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_crosshair1.Help
data.value: Show or hide the aiming cursor for player 1 when using GunCon or Konami Gun. Disable RGB32 output in the video settings for this option to work.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_crosshair2.Help
data.value: Show or hide the aiming cursor for player 2 when using GunCon or Konami Gun. Disable RGB32 output in the video settings for this option to work.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_konamigunadjustx.Help
data.value: Apply an X axis offset to light gun input when emulating a Konami Gun (Hyper Blaster / Justifier) device. Can be used to correct aiming misalignments.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_konamigunadjusty.Help
data.value: Apply a Y axis offset to light gun input when emulating a Konami Gun (Hyper Blaster / Justifier) device. Can be used to correct aiming misalignments.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_gunconadjustx.Help
data.value: Apply an X axis offset to light gun input when emulating a Guncon device. Can be used to correct aiming misalignments.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_gunconadjusty.Help
data.value: Apply a Y axis offset to light gun input when emulating a Guncon device. Can be used to correct aiming misalignments.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_gunconadjustratiox.Help
data.value: Adjust relative magnitude of horizontal light gun motion when emulating a Guncon device. Can be used to correct aiming misalignments.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_gunconadjustratioy.Help
data.value: Adjust relative magnitude of vertical light gun motion when emulating a Guncon device. Can be used to correct aiming misalignments.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_icache_emulation.Help
data.value: Enable emulation of the PSX CPU instruction cache. Improves accuracy at the expense of increased performance overheads. Required for Formula One 2001, Formula One Arcade and Formula One 99. [Interpreter only; partial on lightrec and ARM dynarecs]

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_exception_emulation.Help
data.value: Enable emulation of some almost never used PSX's debug features. This causes a performance hit, is not useful for games and is intended for PSX homebrew and romhack developers only. Only enable if you know what you are doing. [Interpreter only]

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_cd_turbo.Help
data.value: This makes the emulated CD-ROM extremely fast and can reduce loading times in some cases. Warning: many games were not programmed to handle such a speed. The game (or even the emulator) MAY CRASH at ANY TIME if this is enabled.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcsx_rearmed.pcsx_rearmed_nostalls.Help
data.value: Will cause some games to run too quickly. Should be disabled in almost all cases. Interpreter only.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_fast_boot.Help
data.value: Skip the BIOS boot animation. Requires restart.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_renderer.Help
data.value: Hardware renderer API, or the software renderer. Switching to or from Software applies on the fly; switching between hardware APIs takes effect when the content is restarted.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_upscale_multiplier.Help
data.value: Internal rendering resolution multiplier for the hardware renderer. Also scales the output framebuffer. Applies on the fly.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_hw_download_mode.Help
data.value: How GPU->CPU readbacks are handled when a game reads rendered data back (GT3 heat haze, photo modes...). Accurate stalls the whole pipeline on tiler GPUs; Unsynchronized returns stale data without stalling (big speedup, may glitch those effects); Disabled skips them.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_blending_accuracy.Help
data.value: Higher levels emulate more PS2 blending effects correctly at a GPU cost.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_texture_filtering.Help
data.value: Bilinear (PS2) replicates the console; forced modes smooth all textures.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_anisotropic_filtering.Help
data.value: Reduces texture aliasing at steep angles.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_dithering.Help
data.value: Unscaled (default) replicates PS2 dithering; Off can reduce banding artifacts at high resolutions.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_deinterlace_mode.Help
data.value: Automatic uses the GameDB-recommended mode per game.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_audio_buffer_ms.Help
data.value: How much audio the emulator keeps ahead of the frontend. More of it rides out a stall that would otherwise be heard as a break in the sound, at the cost of that much delay before you hear anything. PCSX2's own default is 50 ms, which assumes it is feeding an audio device directly rather than a frontend that pulls once a frame.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_frame_limiter.Help
data.value: What holds the emulator to full speed. Frontend leaves the pacing to RetroArch, which throttles by making the core wait on the audio it hands over. Internal uses PCSX2's own limiter instead - for a device where that wait never happens, because the audio driver underruns rather than blocking, and the emulator's own speed variation then reaches the screen as uneven frame pacing.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_skip_duplicate_frames.Label
data.value: Do not display identical video frames.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_skip_duplicate_frames.Help
data.value: Don't hand the frontend a frame the GS never redrew - a 30fps game then delivers 30 unique frames instead of 60 with every second one repeated. Turn this off if a frame generation or interpolation filter needs every frame delivered as its own.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_aspect_ratio.Help
data.value: Automatic reports 16:9 when widescreen patches are enabled, 4:3 otherwise.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_multitap.Help
data.value: Enable the multitap adapter for up to 8 controllers. Player order follows the physical slots (port 1: 1A-1D, then port 2: 2A-2D). Restart recommended.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_lightgun.Help
data.value: Emulate a Namco GunCon 2 on a USB port, aimed with the frontend's lightgun (or mouse mapped as lightgun) on the matching controller port. Requires restart.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_rumble.Help
data.value: Forward DualShock 2 vibration to the frontend's rumble support.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_axis_scale.Help
data.value: Scales stick input like a real DualShock 2 (PCSX2 default 133%). Lower if diagonals feel clamped.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_axis_deadzone.Help
data.value: Stick deadzone applied inside the emulated controller, on top of any frontend deadzone.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_widescreen_patches.Help
data.value: Enable built-in 16:9 widescreen patches where available. Best applied before starting a game.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_no_interlacing_patches.Help
data.value: Enable built-in progressive-output patches where available. Best applied before starting a game.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_mtvu.Help
data.value: Runs VU1 on its own thread. Large speedup on multi-core CPUs; a small number of games hang with it.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_instant_vu1.Help
data.value: Runs VU1 to completion immediately (ignored while MTVU is enabled). Usually a speedup.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_ee_cycle_rate.Help
data.value: Choose a lower or higher clock speed for the emulated Emotion Engine. The default is 100%. Changing this speed can break games.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_ee_cycle_skip.Help
data.value: Makes the EE skip cycles. Helps some games with high VU activity, breaks others.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_cpu_recompiler.Help
data.value: Enable or disable recompilation for diagnostic purposes. When enabled, EE, IOP, VU0 and VU1 use fast JIT recompilation. This is the default. When disabled, every CPU uses slower instruction interpretation. This helps diagnose JIT errors: a crash that still occurs with recompilation disabled has another cause. The four individual CPU switches below apply only when this master option is enabled. Restart after changing this option.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_rec_ee.Help
data.value: Diagnostic. Disable just the Emotion Engine (EE) dynarec while leaving the others on, to bisect which recompiler causes a crash. Requires restart.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_rec_iop.Help
data.value: Diagnostic. Disable just the IOP (R3000) dynarec while leaving the others on, to bisect which recompiler causes a crash. Requires restart.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_rec_vu0.Help
data.value: Diagnostic. Disable just the VU0 microVU dynarec while leaving the others on, to bisect which recompiler causes a crash. Requires restart.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_rec_vu1.Help
data.value: Diagnostic. Disable just the VU1 microVU dynarec while leaving the others on, to bisect which recompiler causes a crash. Requires restart.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_memcard_slot1_enable.Help
data.value: Enable the Slot 1 PS2 memory card. Changes apply immediately while content is running.

data.name: Emulation.Option.pcee2.pcsx2_memcard_slot2_enable.Help
data.value: Enable the Slot 2 PS2 memory card. Changes apply immediately while content is running.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_ppu_decoder.Help
data.value: Choose how to execute instructions for the PPU, which is the main CPU. Recompilation with LLVM is the fastest method.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_spu_decoder.Help
data.value: Choose how to execute instructions for the SPU coprocessors. Recompilation with LLVM is the fastest method.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_spu_block_size.Help
data.value: SPU recompiler block size. Mega/Giga may improve performance.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_accurate_rsx_reservation.Help
data.value: Synchronize RSX memory accesses with the reservations of the CPU threads. Needed by a few games, slower.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_spu_accurate_dma.Help
data.value: Accurately processes SPU DMA operations, as in RPCS3. Fixes a few games, at a large cost in speed.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_spu_accurate_reservations.Help
data.value: Accurately processes SPU reservations, as in RPCS3 (on by default there too). Turning it off can make some games faster and break others.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_debug_console_mode.Help
data.value: Emulates a PS3 debug console (more memory and debug features) instead of a retail one. Only for software that needs it; not recommended otherwise.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_mfc_delay_command.Help
data.value: Delays every second MFC (SPU DMA) command, as in RPCS3. Only for the few games that need it.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_disable_getllar_spin_opt.Help
data.value: Turn off the detection of SPU busy-wait loops on GETLLAR. A few games need it off.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_emulate_hdd_speed.Help
data.value: Reads from the emulated hard disk at the speed of the PS3's, for games that break when loading is instant.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_emulate_bdvd_speed.Help
data.value: Reads from the disc at the PS3 drive's 2x speed (9 MB/s), for games that stream movies from disc and show corrupted video when loading is instant. Loading takes longer.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_ppu_reservation_priority.Help
data.value: Gives PPU reservations priority over the SPUs', as in RPCS3. Can help games that stall on them.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_llvm_precompilation.Help
data.value: Precompile PPU modules at boot for faster subsequent loads.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_renderer.Help
data.value: Vulkan renders on the frontend's Vulkan device and hands it each finished frame as an image; when the frontend is not running its Vulkan video driver, the frame is copied back through memory instead. OpenGL draws straight into the frontend's OpenGL context. (Restart required)

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_frame_limit.Help
data.value: Highest frame rate the game may run at. Auto is the VBlank Frequency, as in RPCS3; PS3 Native paces flips the way the PS3 does; Off lets games that do not wait for the PS3's refresh themselves run too fast.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_msaa.Help
data.value: Multi-sample anti-aliasing where the game asks for it, as in RPCS3.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_zcull_accuracy.Help
data.value: How exactly occlusion queries are answered, as in RPCS3. Precise is correct and the default there; Approximate and Relaxed are faster, and can break effects such as lens flares. Relaxed is worth trying on phones.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_shader_quality.Help
data.value: Precision of the shaders RPCS3 generates. Low is fastest, Ultra most accurate.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_default_resolution.Help
data.value: The output resolution the emulated PS3 offers the game, as in RPCS3. Most games run at 720p; some look better at 1080p, and some need 480p or 576p to avoid bugs. Takes effect when content is loaded.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_resolution_scale.Help
data.value: Internal rendering resolution as a percentage of the game's own. 200% of a 720p game is 2560x1440, of a 1080p one 3840x2160.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_scale_threshold.Help
data.value: Render targets smaller than this are not scaled. Some games need a different value for the scaling to look right.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_shader_mode.Help
data.value: How shaders are compiled. Async compiles in the background but the frame that first needs a pipeline waits for it, which is what a long freeze on a new scene usually is. Async with Shader Interpreter draws that frame through the interpreter instead and swaps in the compiled shader when it is ready: no freeze, lower speed while it catches up.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_write_color_buffers.Help
data.value: Write color buffers to main memory. Fixes some effects.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_stretch_to_display.Help
data.value: Stretch game output to fill the display, reported to RetroArch at this aspect ratio: pick the display's for games patched to a wider one (21:9, 32:9). Needs RetroArch's aspect ratio set to Core Provided.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_multithreaded_rsx.Help
data.value: Moves part of the RSX work to a second thread. Off by default, as in RPCS3; it can help on CPUs with few fast cores, phones included.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_host_gpu_labels.Help
data.value: Lets the host GPU signal RSX labels itself instead of the CPU waiting on them. Faster in some games, unstable in others.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_disable_blit_upscaling.Label
data.value: Do not increase resolution for image copies made by the graphics processor

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_disable_blit_upscaling.Help
data.value: Keep image copies made by the RSX graphics engine at the original game resolution, as in RPCS3. Do not apply the selected resolution scale to these copies. This fixes effects in some games when using higher resolutions, but these parts of the image may look less sharp.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_disable_vertex_cache.Help
data.value: Turn off the cache of vertex data, as in RPCS3. Slower; only for games that show broken or stale geometry with it.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_emulate_depth_compare.Help
data.value: Emulates the depth comparison modes the PS3 has and the host GPU lacks. Fixes some shadows, at a cost in speed.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_force_hw_msaa_resolve.Help
data.value: Resolves anti-aliased surfaces on the GPU's own hardware instead of a shader. Faster, but some games show artifacts with it.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_handle_tiled_memory.Help
data.value: Emulates the RSX's tiled memory, for games that read their tiled surfaces back. Costs speed.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_read_depth_buffers.Help
data.value: Read depth buffers from main memory.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_read_color_buffers.Help
data.value: Read color buffers from main memory.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_use_rebar.Label
data.value: Use Re-BAR Memory for GPU Uploads

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_use_rebar.Help
data.value: Uploads to the GPU through resizable BAR memory where the Vulkan driver offers it, as in RPCS3 (on by default there too). Turn off if it causes problems.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_write_depth_buffers.Help
data.value: Write depth buffers to main memory.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_driver_wakeup_delay.Help
data.value: Driver wake-up delay in microseconds. 0 by default, as in RPCS3; raise it only when a game needs it.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_vblank_rate.Help
data.value: The PS3's refresh rate in Hz. It is also the frame rate the core asks RetroArch for, which takes effect when content is loaded; games that can run above 60 FPS need a display that refreshes that fast.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_thread_scheduler.Help
data.value: Who places the emulator's threads on the CPU's cores, as in RPCS3. Operating System leaves it to the system; the RPCS3 schedulers pin PPU, SPU and RSX threads to cores of their own, laid out for a few desktop CPUs. Has no effect on Android, where the core cannot pin threads.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_preferred_spu_threads.Help
data.value: Number of SPU threads. Auto recommended.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_spu_loop_detection.Help
data.value: Detects SPU loops that only wait and skips through them. Faster, but some games break with it; off by default, as in RPCS3. Worth turning on for speed on phones.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_llvm_threads.Help
data.value: Choose how many threads compile PPU and SPU code with LLVM. This corresponds to the compilation thread limit in RPCS3. Automatic mode uses all processor cores, except efficiency cores on ARM processors that have them, such as most phones and some laptops. Fewer threads reduce heat and memory use during compilation, but make compilation slower.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_shader_compiler_threads.Label
data.value: Number of threads used to compile shaders

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_shader_compiler_threads.Help
data.value: How many threads compile shaders. Auto lets RPCS3 decide from the CPU it sees. On ARM CPUs with efficiency cores (most phones, some ARM laptops) the default leaves those out.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_ppu_threads.Help
data.value: How many PPU threads run at once, as in RPCS3. 2 is the default and what nearly every game wants.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_max_spurs_threads.Help
data.value: Maximum SPURS thread count. Lower may improve performance.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_max_preempt_count.Help
data.value: How many times a frame RPCS3 may pause the CPU threads to save power, as in RPCS3. 0 turns it off.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_network_enabled.Help
data.value: Lets games reach the internet. Takes effect when content is loaded.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_psn_status.Help
data.value: What games see of the PlayStation Network. Simulated makes them believe they are signed in, which some need to get past their menus; RPCN connects to RPCS3's own server and needs Network Enabled and an RPCN account: the core cannot create one, so set it up in standalone RPCS3 and copy its rpcn.yml into system/rpcs3/ (system/rpcs3/config/ on Windows). Takes effect when content is loaded.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_upnp.Help
data.value: Enable UPnP for automatic port forwarding.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_disable_fifo_reordering.Help
data.value: Turns off the reordering of RSX commands RPCS3 does for speed. For debugging.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_disable_hw_blending.Help
data.value: Forces programmable blending on renderers that support it, as in RPCS3's Debug tab. Purely a debugging option.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_disable_hw_colorspace.Label
data.value: Disable color space conversion in the graphics hardware

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_disable_hw_colorspace.Help
data.value: Remaps texture colour spaces in shaders instead of in the GPU's hardware. For debugging.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_disable_zcull_queries.Help
data.value: Always report that objects are visible, without testing whether another object hides them. This improves speed, but can break games that use these tests for visibility or lens flare effects.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_cpu_blit.Help
data.value: Force CPU blit emulation for certain effects.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_gpu_texture_scaling.Help
data.value: Scales textures on the GPU instead of the CPU. For debugging; can break games.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_spu_events_busy_loop.Help
data.value: Lets SPU threads spin while they wait for events instead of sleeping. Can help a few games, costs CPU time.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_set_daz_ftz.Help
data.value: Sets the denormals-are-zero and flush-to-zero CPU flags for the PPU. For debugging.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_accurate_ppu_128.Help
data.value: Processes 128-byte PPU reservation operations accurately: never, always, or for loops up to the given length. For debugging.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_fb_aliasing_bias.Help
data.value: Which way RPCS3 decides a surface used as both colour and depth. For debugging.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_database_override.Help
data.value: Improves compatibility by automatically applying game-specific fixes: the settings RPCS3's database has for the game (as standalone RPCS3 applies them) take priority over the core options, global or per game, for the settings they name; every other setting stays as you set it. Off applies none of them. Takes effect the next time a game is started.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_perf_overlay.Help
data.value: Display performance information from RPCS3 over the game image. This includes the frame rate measured by RPCS3. Higher detail levels also show the time taken by each frame and the CPU and GPU load.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_frame_pacing.Help
data.value: What the game's frames are timed by. Emulator clock is RPCS3's own timer, as in standalone RPCS3. RetroArch gives the game one PS3 refresh per frame RetroArch shows, so fast-forward speeds the game up and the game runs at the VBlank Frequency when RetroArch shows that many frames a second; with the Vulkan renderer it currently skips frames.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_savedata_slot.Help
data.value: A PS3 game shows a list of its save data and lets the player pick. 'Pick from list' shows that list in the game picture, to be used with the controller. A number has the core pick for you instead: saving overwrites the entry at this position in the game's list, or makes a new save when the list is shorter; loading takes the entry at this position, and finds nothing when the list is shorter. 0 is the first entry. Games that keep a single save of their own do not show a list, so this does not apply to them.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_show_ppu_compilation_hint.Help
data.value: Show hint when PPU modules are being compiled.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_show_shader_compilation_hint.Label
data.value: Show a message while shaders are being compiled

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_show_shader_compilation_hint.Help
data.value: Show hint when shaders are being compiled.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_silence_all_logs.Help
data.value: Silence all log output for performance.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_spu_cache.Help
data.value: Enable SPU cache for faster subsequent loads.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_accurate_dfma.Help
data.value: Double-precision fused multiply-add done exactly, as in RPCS3 (on by default there too). Costs little on CPUs with FMA; turning it off can help on a slow phone, and breaks some games.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_driver_recovery_timeout.Help
data.value: GPU driver recovery timeout in milliseconds.

data.name: Emulation.Option.rpcs3.rpcs3_vblank_ntsc.Help
data.value: Run the VBlank Frequency at the NTSC rate (59.94 Hz for 60) instead of the round number. On by default, as in RPCS3.

data.name: Emulation.Option.play.Resolution.Help
data.value: Selects the internal rendering resolution multiplier.

data.name: Emulation.Option.play.Presentation.Help
data.value: Fits the image, fills the screen or preserves the original size.

data.name: Emulation.Option.play.Bilinear.Help
data.value: Forces bilinear texture filtering in the renderer.
